title: Critique: strong AI and functionalism rest on a residual dualism

statements.text: In strong AI, and in functionalism, what matters are programs, which are independent of their realization. That makes sense only on the dualistic assumption that where the mind is concerned the brain does not matter: a program could run on an electronic machine, a Cartesian mental substance or a Hegelian world spirit.
